scientific_integrity: An explicit all-order induction proves the claim; a reproducible program supplies supplementary finite exact-arithmetic and Gaussian-quadrature tests. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the central second derivative and local extremum type are classified at each finite Hermite order. Global extrema, other stationary thresholds, and independent historical priority are not asserted. The normalization of the Hermite coordinate determines the numerical curvature.
title: Alternating center curvature of every finite Hermite half-line concentration defect
